setup: Two sides of a triangle are \([[given_a]]\) and \([[given_b]]\), and you are asked for the extreme whole number the third side can take.

steps.say: The triangle inequality says each side is shorter than the other two added, so the third side must be strictly below \([[bound]]\).
It also says each side is longer than the difference of the other two, which is \([[difference]]\) here. Both bounds come from the same inequality, read in opposite directions.

answer: So the third side is \([[side]]\) units long.
